title.zh: 新增运行时与游戏兼容修复

zh: 新增 ADV Player HD（Beta）及 System3 / System35 运行时，并改进 System4 兼容性。
修复 KiriKiri 立绘、启动与剧情演出，改善 BGI 和 Siglus 游戏兼容性。
改进 YU-RIS 翻译、存读档、动画与帧节奏，修复 ADVHD 存档及场景恢复。
支持打包的 Tyrano / Electron 游戏导入，修复 SoftPal、RFVP 启动与 System4 翻译资源加载。
en: Added ADV Player HD (Beta) and System3 / System35 runtimes, with System4 compatibility improvements.
Fixed KiriKiri character rendering, startup and story effects, and improved BGI and Siglus compatibility.
Improved YU-RIS translation, saves, animation and frame cadence, plus ADVHD saves and scene restoration.
Added packed Tyrano / Electron game imports and fixed SoftPal and RFVP startup and System4 translated resources.

title.zh: 新引擎支持与补丁兼容

zh: 新增 Escu:de / ACPX 游戏支持，并支持使用原版界面的 SystemC 游戏。
修复 KiriKiri 补丁兼容和启动问题。
修复 YU-RIS 语音与角色转场。
加入共享 Lua 回退机制及原生翻译支持。
en: Added Escu:de / ACPX game support and SystemC games with their original UI.
Fixed KiriKiri patch compatibility and startup regressions.
Fixed YU-RIS voice playback and character transitions.
Added shared Lua fallback hooks and native translation support.
